title: Derived evaluation of the subsequence left extension
statement:
For every m, the derived subsequence extension evaluated at m is naturally the derived tensor extension of evaluation at t_r(m) along B_r(t_r(m))→B_m. Its inverse comparison followed by the evaluated map intertwines the scalar derived Hom transpose with the actual subsequence adjunction transpose, selected-evaluation comparison, and actual derived transition from r(t_r(m)) to m.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (S : SystemScalarAssignment (J := J)) (T : SystemTensorCoherence S)
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ) (m : ℕ)
theorem systemSelectedDerivedTranspose
    (P : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem (selectedSystemRings B r)))
    (M : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem B))
    (f : (systemSelectedDerivedExtension B r S T).derived.obj P ⟶ M) :
    (systemDerivedTensorAdj S B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).homEquiv
      ((derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B r) (systemNextSelected r m)).obj P)
      ((derivedSystemEvaluation B m).obj M)
      ((systemSelectedDerivedBelow B r m S T).inv.app P ≫
        (derivedSystemEvaluation B m).map f) =
    (derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B r) (systemNextSelected r m)).map
      ((systemSelectedDerivedExtension B r S T).adjunction.homEquiv P M f) ≫
      (systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation B r (systemNextSelected r m)).hom.app M ≫
      (systemDerivedTransition B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).app M
```

proof.text: The right selected-evaluation square is exact selected evaluation followed by the actual derived transition. Its cochain representative is the same strict transition by the two factorization equations. The ordinary tensor comparison satisfies the unit-mate identity by the ordinary selected transpose theorem. The simultaneous componentwise flat-term K-flat resolving class is sent by evaluation into the scalar resolving class. Apply the general normalized evaluation-mate isomorphism theorem and its Hom transpose formula.
